description: ESO Multi-Mode Instrument (EMMI) on the NTT: filter-only lab transmission of its ESO-numbered filters from the ESO filter database (ESO-MIDAS XFilter) and the EMMI filter page.

licence.terms: "ESO-MIDAS is available under the GNU General Public License (GPL), and can be implemented on UNIX/Linux and Mac OSX systems." (https://www.eso.org/sci/software/esomidas.html; the curves are the XFilter database distributed in ESO-MIDAS's calib_src.tar.gz, which carries no separate licence file)
licence.scope: Statement about the ESO-MIDAS system on ESO's MIDAS page; applied here to the filter tables shipped in the MIDAS calibration tarball. Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: ESO numbers from SVO's descriptions, checked against the data: SVO's EMMI.Spec_472 and EMMI.Spec_489 carry the wrong numbers (data = ESO #672 and #765). #795/#796 from the EMMI page archive (www.ls.eso.org/lasilla/sciops/ntt/emmi/archive/filters/), whose footer has no licence.
